description: This Java class defines an internal command 'SudoRetrieveThings' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to retrieve multiple 'Thing' objects based on their IDs without authorization. It includes methods for constructing the command, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON, as well as handling command headers and JSON field selection.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThings
classes.description: A command class for internally retrieving multiple 'Thing' objects by their IDs within the Eclipse Ditto framework, without requiring authorization. It supports JSON serialization/deserialization, header management, and equals/hashCode implementations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of SudoRetrieveThings with different parameters.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods to parse a SudoRetrieveThings instance from JSON in String or JsonObject form.

methods.name: getThingIds
methods.description: Returns the list of Thing IDs to be retrieved.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonFieldSelector specifying which fields to include.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload into a JSON object, including thing IDs and optional selected fields.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is QUERY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on thing IDs, selected fields, and superclass.

methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on class, thing IDs, selected fields, and superclass.
